text:
jen: Heads-up — HelixHealth POC seeing repeated 429s during mixed embeddings+rerank run, ~30s in with 6 workers. Need triage.
omar: Can you paste a failing response (headers + X-Request-ID) and confirm client retry behavior?
jen: Header capture: `HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
X-RateLimit-Limit: 1500
X-RateLimit-Remaining: 0
X-RateLimit-Reset: 1729001300
x-redeemed-route-credit: 0` They retried aggressively with no backoff.
rachel: Tenant shows rerank route override = 300/min and trial set to isolated per-route bucket. That small rerank bucket explains it.
quota-bot: Auto: tenant helix state=THROTTLED; rerank softcap hit. Recommend temp bump +700/min for 90m.
omar: I'll apply temporary bump and tell them to reduce concurrency, add jitter and exponential backoff, cap retries to 3.
jen: Bump applied; customer reran with jitter + 3 retries max. 5/6 runs succeeded, 1 still hit 429 (immediate retry). We advised client to add 500ms jitter and exponential backoff.
rachel: Follow-ups: file INFRA ticket for per-route sizing race, update trial defaults, add per-route token pressure metric in Console.
jen: Sales updated, customer stays green for now. :thumbsup:
